The City of Brampton 2025 Fall Orthophoto was captured at 10 cm resolution and orthorectified.
An orthophoto, orthophotograph or orthoimage is an aerial photograph geometrically corrected ("orthorectified") such that the scale is uniform: the photo has the same lack of distortion as a map. Unlike an uncorrected aerial photograph, an orthophotograph can be used to measure true distances, because it is an accurate representation of the Earth's surface, having been adjusted for topographic relief, lens distortion, and camera tilt. - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orthophoto
